description: Report-only follow-up: the measure-guard end-of-turn follow-up and reminder report the open problems instead of ordering a fix. The shared core holds the report-only text, and the OpenCode plugin, the Claude Code mod, and the DSH adapter use it. The text never asks the agent to edit, commit, or push (PM order, 2026-11-17)
